item.title: Write a Note About the Fan
item.prompt_text: You are reading at the table. The fan is on high and it is loud. Ask Dana to turn it down. Say you still want the fan on and tell Dana when you finish reading.
item.audience: a person sharing your study room
item.target_grammar: Can you or please for a request. Keep it on for a continued action.
item.target_structure: Say the problem, make the request, and add the time.

checklist.point: Ask Dana to turn it down and keep it on.
